TypeRacer
Online game
TypeRacer is a free, multiplayer online competitive typing game where players race cars by typing displayed text as fast and accurately as possible. 
TypeRacer
 +2
How It Works
Gameplay: Participants are placed in a virtual lobby and given the exact same text prompt—typically quotes from books, movies, or songs. 
YouTube
·Team Liquid
Mechanics: Each player is represented by a small car on a track. As you type characters correctly, your car accelerates forward. Making a mistake requires you to use the backspace key to correct the error before you can advance further. 
OpenAI
 +1
Scoring: Performance is measured in Words Per Minute (WPM) and accuracy percentage. The first player to correctly type the entire passage wins the race. 
YouTube
·Team Liquid
Key Features
Multiplayer & Friends: Race against random opponents globally or create a custom link to race against friends in a private room. 
TypeRacer
 +1
Statistics Tracking: The platform records your progress, including your average speed over recent races, all-time best speed, total races completed, and win percentage. 
YouTube
·PC-Addicts
Accessibility: It is entirely browser-based with nothing to download, making it widely used for casual practice or competitive typing training.
